Alright, I've been making a lot of incremental fixes across the project: correcting map data, adding UI, battle, overworld modules, and tweaking input mappings. The last few edits were focused on making the control scheme more intuitive—specifically, I changed the key bindings in `js/input.js` so that `Space` now acts as the “A” button (confirm/interact) and moved the menu action to `Enter` and `M`. That change was reflected in the code, but the on‑screen help text in `index.html` still describes the old layout: it mentions “Z/Enter: A” and “Enter: menu (in overworld via Z on... press M or Enter)”. This mismatch will confuse anyone testing the game, because the UI will show one set of controls while the actual input handling does something else.

I need to bring the help text in sync with the new input mapping. Looking at `index.html`, there is a paragraph that lists the controls. The relevant snippet currently reads:

```
  Arrows/WASD: move  |  Z/Enter: A (confirm/interact)  |  X/Esc: B (cancel/run)
   |  Enter: menu (in overworld via Z on... press M or Enter)
```

Given the changes in `input.js`, the correct description should be:

- “Z/Space” as the A button (since I mapped Space to `'a'` and kept Z as well).
- “X/Esc” remains B.
- The menu should be accessed via “Enter” or “M”, not via Z. So I should rewrite the second line to reflect that.

Thus I will replace the old string with:

```
  Arrows/WASD: move  |  Z/Space: A (confirm/interact/fish)  |  X/Esc: B (cancel)
   |  Enter/M: menu (Pokédex, party, bag, save)
```

I’m adding “fish” to the A button description because the game uses the A button for fishing too, and I’m clarifying that the menu opens the various UI screens. This edit will make the UI instructions accurate and improve the user experience.

Since this is a single textual replacement and I only want to change this specific occurrence, I’ll use the Edit tool with `replace_all: false`, targeting the exact old string and substituting the new one. That should resolve the inconsistency without affecting any other parts of the file.
